## Biography

<p class="bio-note">For event organisers and editors: this biography may be reused as written.</p>

Dr Justin C Yang is a psychiatric epidemiologist and Senior Research Fellow in the Division of Psychiatry at University College London, and an Associate Editor of *Addiction*. Dr Yang's research asks what happens to people whose needs fall between services, such as school and health care, mental health and addiction treatment, and health and social care: who is identified, who reaches treatment or support, and who falls through the gaps.

Dr Yang holds a UKRI Mental Health Platform Cross-Hub Fellowship (WISDOM, 2026 to 2029), and has led an NIHR Team Science award on England's national drug and alcohol treatment data (UNITED) and an ADR UK fellowship on the education and health of neurodivergent pupils (HOPE-SEN). Dr Yang is Deputy Lead of the North London NHS Foundation Trust research database and an Expert Member of the Health Research Authority's Confidentiality Advisory Group, and holds a PhD in Public Health and Primary Care from the University of Cambridge and an MSPH in Health Policy from Johns Hopkins University.

## Manuscript review

I review manuscripts across psychiatry, epidemiology, substance use, public health, and health services research. The list below is generated from my ORCID peer-review record.

```{r results='asis', echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, error=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(httr2)
library(rcrossref)

orcid_id <- "0000-0003-2881-4906"

resp <- request(
  paste0(
    "https://pub.orcid.org/v3.0/",
    orcid_id,
    "/peer-reviews"
  )
) |>
  req_headers(Accept = "application/json") |>
  req_error(is_error = \(r) FALSE) |>
  req_perform()

if (resp_status(resp) == 200) {

  body <- resp_body_json(resp)

  raw <- map_chr(body$group, \(g) {
    val <- tryCatch(
      g$`external-ids`$`external-id`[[1]]$`external-id-value`,
      error = \(e) NA_character_
    )

    if (is.null(val)) NA_character_ else val
  })

  issns_clean <- raw[
    !is.na(raw) &
      str_starts(raw, "issn:")
  ] |>
    str_remove("^issn:") |>
    unique()

  get_title_from_issn <- function(issn) {
    tryCatch({
      result <- rcrossref::cr_journals(issn)$data$title
      if (is.null(result) || length(result) == 0) {
        return(NA_character_)
      }
      result[[1]]
    }, error = \(e) NA_character_)
  }

  journal_names <- map_chr(
    issns_clean,
    get_title_from_issn
  ) |>
    (\(x) x[!is.na(x)])() |>
    unique() |>
    str_squish() |>
    str_replace("Men s", "Men's") |>
    (\(x) x[
      order(
        str_remove(
          x,
          regex(
            "^(the|a|an)\\s+",
            ignore_case = TRUE
          )
        )
      )
    ])()

  if (length(journal_names) > 0) {
    cat(
      "<details>\n",
      "<summary><b>Selected journals for which I have served as a peer reviewer</b></summary>\n\n",
      paste0("- ", journal_names, collapse = "\n"),
      "\n\n</details>\n"
    )
  }
}
```
